name: pr-shepherd
description: Cross-session PR/merge shepherd with beads (bd) as the central state store. Merge work lives as beads labeled agent:integrator with gh:pr/gh:run gate beads owning async waits; any session (or a /loop or cron invocation) drains the queue: bd gate check, atomic claim, merge-tree conflict probe + gh PR state, then either a slot-guarded merge or a bounce-back fix bead routed to agent:coder that parks the merge bead until fixed. Ships the pr-shepherd skill, a standalone pr-shepherd agent, steering for the merge-bead lifecycle and bounce-back protocol. Requires the bd CLI (gastownhall/beads >= 1.1.0) and gh; optionally consumes release-queue-watch lifecycle and dispatch records with durable crash-replay receipts. All parts are inert in repos without .beads/.
